kashika: संज्ञायां विषये मतोर्व इत्ययमादेशो भवति। अहीवती। कपीवती। ऋषीवती। मुनीवती॥
kashikaEnglish: म् of मतुप् → व् when word is a name. आहीवती, कपीवती, ऋषीवती.
englishFull:
न सयुक्तान्तात् सत्वोपधात् — **Blocking Condition**: @[nalopa] does @b[not] occur when the stem ends in a conjunct and has स् as its penultimate sound.

Example: दोष्न् (from दोषन् "arm") retains न् because of the preceding ष्.
